objective: Implement a correct and fast general CUDA kernel for vector_add on the complete public shape domain. Exact evaluator cases are private; specialization may use runtime tensor properties and declared public parameters only.

evaluation.performance_requirement: performance is measured across hidden cases after correctness passes

operator_contract.name: vector_add
operator_contract.semantics: Return a new contiguous tensor whose every element is x[i] + y[i], preserving the input dtype and shape without mutating either input.

authoritative_public_sources.reference.py: exact operator computation and return semantics
authoritative_public_sources.input.py: runtime argument construction, dtypes, layouts and value generation

workload_profile.dispatch_basis: runtime tensor properties and public input parameters

distribution_profile.policy: Treat every point admitted by shape_domain as relevant; do not assume private case frequencies.

invariants: x and y have the same one-dimensional shape, dtype, device and contiguous layout.
The returned tensor has the same shape and dtype and equals x + y elementwise.
Neither input tensor is mutated or aliased by the output.
Dispatch may use runtime tensor properties and declared public parameters, never evaluator case IDs or a reconstructed private case table.

coverage_regimes.name: n
coverage_regimes.requirement: Support the complete range, including boundaries, small vectors and lengths that leave partial CUDA blocks.
